bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
ROOT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"
WT="$ROOT/.worktrees/gaybbs-menu-20261115"
test "$(git -C "$WT" rev-parse HEAD)" = "1c82a37671737af34b6db5cb960915868f876dc0"
LOG="$(mktemp)"
trap 'rm -f "$LOG"' EXIT
if docker build --network=host --progress=plain -f "$WT/artifacts/bot/deploy/Dockerfile.gaybbs" -t gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-20261115 "$WT" >"$LOG" 2>&1; then
 docker image inspect gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:menu-20261115 >/dev/null
 echo MENU_IMAGE_BUILT=PASS
 exit 0
fi
if grep -Eq 'ERR_PNPM|pnpm .*error|ERR_PNPM_OUTDATED_LOCKFILE|Cannot install with "frozen-lockfile"' "$LOG"; then exit 51; fi
if grep -Eq 'no space left|No space left|ENOSPC' "$LOG"; then exit 52; fi
if grep -Eq 'network is unreachable|connection reset|ETIMEDOUT|ECONNREFUSED|Temporary failure|TLS handshake' "$LOG"; then exit 53; fi
if grep -Eq 'failed to solve|failed to load metadata|pull access denied|not found' "$LOG"; then exit 54; fi
exit 55
